//: HOW TO FORMAT THIS FILE (read by tools/build_buildings.py; run it after editing)
Photos of buildings. Each key is the photo key a building has in BUILDINGS in tools/build_buildings.py.
Its value is a list of photos, each:
"file": "data/photos/zuhl-library-1.jpg"   the photo in this project (null = found, but not usable or not downloaded)
"sourceUrl": "https://..."                 the page the photo comes from (shown as the credit link)
"license": "CC BY-SA 3.0"                  the licence, copied from the source page
"author": "Name"                           who took it, copied from the source page
"verifiedHow": "..."                       how we checked it really shows this building
Only use photos whose licence allows it, and credit them exactly as the source page says.
